curriculum.title: Cambridge Primary Global Perspectives
curriculum.note: This class folder on Google Drive is empty. The objectives below are taken verbatim from the Stage 2 column of the 0838 Primary Global Perspectives Progression Grid, which is in the Primary 1 folder and covers every stage. The five challenge topics are chosen by the school; the skills they develop are fixed by the framework. Stage 2 has no objective for the Being an effective team sub-strand, which is why it does not appear.

objectives.title: Recognise that different people know different things about an issue
Recognise that graphical and numerical data can show information about an issue
Talk about simple, personal consequences of own actions on others
Suggest a personal action that could make a positive difference to an issue affecting self
Work positively with others, contributing to a shared outcome by carrying out tasks
Talk about a given issue, giving relevant information
Listen to others in class discussions and respond with simple and relevant questions
Suggest sources which might be relevant to an issue, explaining reasons for relevance
Express an opinion about a given issue, giving reasons for opinion
Identify personal contribution in the form of an idea intended to help achieve a shared outcome
Identify an idea that someone else contributed to achieve a shared outcome
Talk about what has been learned during an activity
Talk about a particular activity that supported learning
Ask focused questions about a given issue
Locate relevant information in sources provided
Conduct simple investigations, using interviews or questionnaires to find information and opinions
Record findings from primary research in pictograms, simple tables or graphic organisers
